notes: Shame is the dungeon of elementals and winding caves, so it takes dripstone, crystal and the dark smears of a fight. Crystals suggest elemental cores without being a species trophy. The Emerald Crystal Cluster is the showpiece.

entries.why: Slender stalagmites, wet with slow water.
Sprawled skeleton flung across the flags.
Rust-stained stalagmite, iron in the water.
Green crystal shard on a stone plinth.
Emerald Crystal Cluster, an elemental's heart-stone.
